stages.title: Foundations
stages.milestone: Create and run a small Angular application with a clear project structure.

stages.title: Components and templates
stages.milestone: Build a responsive reusable interface with component composition and accessible template behavior.

stages.title: State, services and navigation
stages.milestone: Build multi-page features with shared state, dependency injection and route data.

stages.title: Forms and backend communication
stages.milestone: Create validated user journeys connected to an API with clear failure handling.

stages.title: Architecture and quality
stages.milestone: Deliver a tested intermediate application with measured quality and security boundaries.

stages.title: Production readiness
stages.milestone: Choose rendering and localization strategies, deploy repeatably and maintain upgrades.

stages.title: Advanced engineering and capstone
stages.milestone: Integrate, test, secure, document and demonstrate a substantial application.

dependency_map.from: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and basic programming

dependency_map.to: Shared state and async error recovery
Testing, performance, security, SSR and deployment
Advanced architecture and the commerce capstone

prerequisite_guidance: Learn basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript and command-line use first. TypeScript is required for idiomatic Angular work. Build a small working feature before advancing into state architecture, SSR or migration.
